text_block_list.name: Student at Camp A
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, this sun, this sand...! 
Summer training camp really is brutal~!

text_block_list.name: Student at Camp B
text_block_list.text:
Well, sure it's rough, but... 
some girls look like they're having a 
blast, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! The mountains are wonderful, of 
course, but the sea is truly lovely as 
well, 
don't you think, Tore-san?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It's ideal for our training, but beyond 
that... 
take this branch, for instance. Doesn't it 
seem like it could be put to good use?
choice_data_list:
...Ah. If we dry it out, could it work as 
shelter material?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! And this sturdy bone lying here could 
be useful too. If carved carefully—
choice_data_list: Right. It could make a fishhook...!

text_block_list.name: Student at Camp A
text_block_list.text: ...Th-They're having fun, huh...?

text_block_list.name: Student at Camp B
text_block_list.text:
*gasp* *pant*...! This trekking course is 
killing meee...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Oh. I hear running water. 
There must be a river just ahead.
choice_data_list: That secures a water source.
That secures a water source.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And it isn't in a flood path either— 
which makes this an ideal spot for a 
shelter.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If we can gather clay near the riverbank, 
we could even craft lovely earthenware... 
This area seems so richly rewarding to 
explore!
choice_data_list: Man, this gets your heart racing.
Man, this gets your heart racing.

text_block_list.name: Student at Camp B
text_block_list.text:
...Wait a second. I thought this was a 
racing camp... 
Why does it feel like some people showed 
up for an entirely different kind of 
camp...?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While we were thoroughly enjoying our 
fruitful camp like that— 
one night, something happened.
choice_data_list:
Some students haven't returned to the 
lodge?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, they went out for a test of 
courage and hadn't come back. 
A search party was immediately organized, 
and I joined in.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —Um, Tore-san!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Please, allow me to help as well!
choice_data_list: No, leave this to the adults.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I won't be a burden, I promise. 
I am accustomed to the woods at night.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Being able to help in times like this is 
the whole reason I've learned so much from 
nature. So please... let me come!
choice_data_list:
...Understood. Just make sure you stay 
close to me.

...Understood. Just make sure you stay 
close to me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
HELLOOOO—!! If you can hear us, 
PLEASE ANSWER—!!
choice_data_list: Even if you hear us, stay where you are!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...If our voices reach them even a little, 
it should help ease their anxiety. 
Let's keep going. We must be very careful 
ourselves—
choice_data_list:
Right. Let's mark the trees as we move 
forward.

Yeah. Let's mark the trees as we move 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...The trail is growing fainter and 
fainter. 
If anyone were to lose their way, it would 
likely be around here...
choice_data_list: Wait... isn't this a keychain?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
! Good eye. 
It's buried so deep under the fallen 
leaves...
choice_data_list:
Something about it just... felt out of 
place, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. As expected of someone who 
conquered our survival trek.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, over here! Footprints. 
...I can make out the shape of horseshoes. 
Let's follow them!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...It's hard to believe they would have 
crossed this raging mountain stream, 
though... 
Let me search for some tracks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With so many rocks around, tracking 
footprints is difficult. 
Which means we need another clue—
choice_data_list: (...Hm? What's this...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
choice_data_list: W-What was that sound...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
An animal snapping a twig underfoot. 
...It's alright. From the volume, I'd say 
it's a deer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Back during our survival camp, she told me 
that animals like bears and deer step 
cautiously and rarely make a sound, but 
even they snap twigs on occasion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There are snapped twigs here, too. 
However—this is too wide an area and too 
careless to have been an animal.
choice_data_list: (Could this be...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Indeed, just as you say, 
I believe something snapped these branches 
as it trampled through.
choice_data_list: If we follow this, maybe...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Though... whether these were snapped 
by the ones who went test-of-courage... 
I can't say with certainty either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—True, it's not unusual for students to 
run these mountain trails during camp. 
It's entirely possible that those girls 
just happened to step on them.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
............ 
What are your thoughts, Tore-san?
choice_data_list: ...Mine?
...Mine?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Whether these branches were broken by 
those who lost their way or not.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Whether they're fresh or old. Or perhaps 
trodden heedlessly, or trodden in fear. 
...I would like to hear your perspective.
choice_data_list: ...I think...
...I think...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Recalling what she said earlier, I look 
closely— 
The distance between branches. Are these 
traces of running, or of walking?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And are they signs of moving calmly with 
proper spacing between each other, 
or of huddling together anxiously as they 
walked—
choice_data_list:
...I really think it's from the lost 
girls.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
............ I feel the same. 
—Then let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She said nothing more and asked for no 
reasons. 
Together, we simply traced the trail of 
snapped branches.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, though we're 
trekking through a pitch-black forest, I 
don't feel the least bit uneasy. 
Strangely enough, I don't even feel tired.
choice_data_list: (...Is it because Daring Tact is here?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, my pace and even my 
breathing seemed to fall into sync with 
hers. 
Even near-impassable animal trails posed 
no hardship as we pushed on—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (*snap*)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ! Tore-san! Just now—
choice_data_list:
The sound of a snapping twig... It must be 
the students!

The sound of a snapping twig... It must be 
the students!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Helloooo—!! 
Is someone there—?!
choice_data_list: Helloooo—!!

text_block_list.name: Student at Camp A
text_block_list.text:
! D-Did you come to rescue us?! 
Over here—!!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, following the trail led us right 
to the students, 
bringing the situation to a safe 
conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad no one was hurt. 
Tore-san, you were truly a huge help.
choice_data_list: No, no. Almost all the credit goes to you.
No, no. Almost all the credit goes to you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
............ Tore-san. Back then, 
why do you think I decided to follow those 
broken branches?
choice_data_list:
Wasn't it... because you felt the same 
way?

Wasn't it... because you felt the same 
way?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I felt that way too. 
...However, more than anything—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—Tore-san. It was because I felt you 
were sensing the very same thing as me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It was a wondrous sensation. At that 
moment—just by looking into your eyes, 
I somehow knew what you were thinking.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Both I and this person felt it together. 
So there was no doubt—that's what made me 
certain.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Ever since I was little, I've often 
looked on in admiration. 
Watching pairs of raccoon dogs and herds 
of deer walk calmly through the dark 
forest.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Surely it's because they have companions 
they can understand and trust. 
That is why they can survive out there 
without fear—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
What those animals feel— 
I think this was the first time I truly 
understood it myself.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Tore-san. Walking through nature alongside 
you.
choice_data_list:
...I wonder if I've gotten closer to you, 
too.

...I wonder if I've gotten closer to you, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes. We make... a fine "pack"!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
No matter where we are... I know the two 
of us 
can carve out a path and survive together!
